[[Vault-Tec Corporation]] |role =Vault dweller |TV actor =[[Rajat Suresh]] }} '''Clark''' is a resident of [[Vault 31]] who appears in the [[Fallout TV series season 2|second season]] of the [[Fallout (TV series)|''Fallout'' TV series]]. ==Background== A [[Vault-Tec Corporation|Vault-Tec]] employee and one of the cryogenically frozen residents of [[Vault 31]], Clark is a participant in the "[[Bud's Buds]]" program, created and run by [[Bud Askins]]. The program selected employees from the Recruitment and Research and Development departments to breed with other residents to create "super managers" in [[Vault 32|Vaults 32]] and [[Vault 33|33]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Golden Rule]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ===[[The Demon in the Snow]]=== {{Section|FOTV}} ===[[The Wrangler]]=== {{Section|FOTV}} ===[[The Handoff]]=== {{section|FOTV}} ==Appearances== Clark appears only {{In|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|10=202|12=204|13=205|15=207}} ==Gallery== Hank Clark and Pete at LA airport.png|Clark, [[Hank MacLean]] and [[Pete (TV series)|Pete]] pre-War, at the [[Los Angeles International Airport]] in "[[The Wrangler]]" FTV S2E7 Still 076.png|Clark with [[Ronnie McCurtry]] {{Stub|FOTV}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 31 characters]] [[Category:Vault-Tec characters]] [[ru:Кларк (телесериал)]]
